policy: Authored before any relation code ran or was measured. The service is given the gold entities as if a person had accepted them, so this measures relations only. A relation is [type, subject text, object text] and must be asserted as current fact in the sentence. Types: works_at (person to organization; employment, 'joined', 'CEO of'), member_of (person to organization or project; membership or leading), located_in (organization, event or project to location; 'based in', 'headquartered in', 'has offices in', 'located in'; a trailing 'in <place>' after 'works at/visited <org>' is not annotated because the attachment is ambiguous; 'founded in' is not located_in), attended (person to event; includes speaking at or presenting at), part_of (component to model or project; model to model or project; organization to organization such as a subsidiary), collaborated_with (person and person who worked together; subject is the earlier mention; meeting, friendship and marriage are not collaboration). Not annotated: negated statements ('did not join', 'never worked'), hedged statements ('may', 'might'), ended relationships ('left'), co-occurrence without a stated relation, pairs outside the allowed types, relations whose subject and object are in different sentences. Phrasing may put the object first ('Lahore is home to Northwind'); the annotation records the true direction. Split: dev (first 20) may be used for tuning; evaluation (last 20) is held out and read only after the dev tuning is frozen.
